newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Calif. Microwave cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Calif. Microwave cut.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it cuts its fourth quarter (ending June 30) and fiscal 1998 earnings and revenue estimates for California Microwave.

-- cut its fourth quarter forecast to $0.01 a share on revenues of $99.3 million, from $0.12 a share on revenues of $118 million, and lowered its fiscal 1998 estimate to $0.17 a share on sales of $427.3 million, from $0.86 a share on sales of $482.2 million.

-- In a statement, Hambrecht said that despite increases in bookings and backlog, it believes California Microwave is not participating in the U.S. build-out for personal communications services to the extent of its competitors.
-- Hambrecht also said it expects "flattish" revenues in the future as management focuses on restructuring, and it "remains cautious until we see evidence of improved execution."
-- Hambrecht maintains a hold rating on the stock.
